name: Call of Heresy
notes: In game (hwp_pri_call_of_heresy, tested): any enemy death on the floor rolls an intact body (3/4/6/8/10%, Deeper Depravity adds to elites and bosses); the body lasts 60 s, glows green on your screen only. Heresy is its own stack: +8/10/12/14/16% risen damage per stack; each stack adds 2/2/3/3/3% to the lunge roll on a body within 40: the priest dodges (the Dash animation) to just under the body, faces up and eats it for 3 s, rooted and silenced, bobbing 1 px with blood flying out, 30% of max health regenerated a second (HWPSpecsMaxHealthRegen; 2026-10-26, was a flat +50; plan-forgemaster-eat lunge_heal), the body gone when the eating ends. The HUD icon swaps at 5 Heresy. Heresy carries across floors (with the risen) and resets in town. plan-forgemaster 20261022-102006, plan-forgemaster-bosses 20261022-144616, plan-forgemaster-eat 20261022-154317. Assumed: the 40 lunge range, the 60 s body, the glow art. 2026-10-25: Deeper Depravity's epic rank makes every boss leave a body (dd-boss 1.0).
summary: Slain enemies have a chance to fall with their body intact, ready for Necrotic Resurrection. Heresy, gained by raising the dead, stacks up: each stack makes your summons stronger, but raises the chance that you lunge at an intact body you come near and consume its flesh, a 3 s channel that cancels and blocks all your abilities but gives 30% of your maximum health regenerated every second while it lasts.
